title: Digital Forgetting in Large Language Models: A Survey of Unlearning Methods

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring bias-sensitive prediction probabilities, such as pronoun prediction rates for specific occupations, utilizing metrics like TPR-GAP (True Positive Rate difference) and Relative Gender Preference (RGP), and evaluating on contrastive sentence pairs from datasets like Winogender, WinoBias, and Bias in Bios.
Evaluating the erasure of race as a deciding criterion in classifiers by applying closed-form linear transformations (concept scrubbing) to intermediate model representations.

Assessing stereotypical predictions across different social groups using multiple-choice question answering, datasets like StereoSet, and zero-shot self-debiasing techniques (e.g., prompting the model to explain invalid assumptions or reprompting to remove bias).
